description: The collaborating Spanish transport researchers publish aerial imagery from eight roundabouts in a regional Spanish sample with vehicle annotations and location metadata. The release includes 15,474 extracted images and augmented variants, yielding 61,896 JPG images at 1920-by-1080 pixels. PASCAL VOC XML files locate vehicles, while CSV tables describe scenes and roundabouts. The public Zenodo deposit permits free reuse under CC BY 4.0. These observations can train traffic-counting systems and provide calibration inputs for roundabout simulations. Augmented images are not independent observations, and inconsistent truck counts between the repository narrative and table remains unresolved. The individual labels and counts were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
